title: Woman with COVID woke up travelling toward heaven
content:
February 15, 2022, I tested positive for COVID. By May 15 th , I had a 104-degree fever and had started to write a death diary.

As I caught COVID on the job at the hospital (as a former healthcare worker), I decided to stay home and fight this on my own. The night I had the 104-degree fever, I prayed and told God that I left my health and my life in his hands, and I woke up traveling to heaven. I thought it was a dream for months.

I'm a changed woman. There is so much more to this. I wish I could remember everything. I feel if I could be hypnotized, maybe I might be able to remember everything. This is my first public account of my experience.
